entries.mem0ai/mem0: The official Hermes Agent memory provider offering a universal memory layer available as a managed cloud or self-hosted OSS. It features multi-level state management for users and sessions combined with time-aware, hybrid retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at massive scale. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance with native connectors for Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses a three-tier context loading system to significantly reduce token costs and improve task completion. It organizes memories via a filesystem-based structure and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to automatically extract typed entity relationships. It includes a synthesis layer for cited answers and an autonomous dream cycle for overnight memory consolidation.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent growth. It provides a simple two-line LLM wrapper compatible with a wide array of local and cloud providers.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from conversations and events rather than just storing raw data. It employs peer-centric modeling and a hybrid BM25 and vector search approach.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that treats memory as a git repository, allowing for branching, merging, and versioning of context trees. It offers five tiers of retrieval, including four non-LLM tiers for sub-100ms performance.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system utilizing SQLite to achieve sub-millisecond retrieval latency. It is MCP-ready for clients like Cursor and Claude Code and supports episodic memory compression.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that distills lessons from complex tasks into reusable playbooks. It generates structured output including traces and evaluation reports via CLI, SDKs, and MCP.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG to condense long sessions without losing messages. It externalizes large payloads to maintain SQLite performance while allowing precise retrieval and expansion.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for the Honcho library that enables private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible provider and includes automated Docker and PostgreSQL setup scripts.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores data locally using an open engram YAML format. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding retrieval for zero-cost context injection across MCP-compatible tools.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other MCP clients. It uses SQLite for custody and includes tools to manually edit or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It combines BM25, vector search, and knowledge graphs via MCP server and agent plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that reduces prefill latency and token usage by up to 44% through prefix reuse and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via 'why_retrieved' tags. It features first-class contradiction tracking and canonicalization without requiring a separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to reduce prompt noise.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that uses ranked graph traversal and edge-based relationships for semantic search. It automates the indexing of documents and media via OCR and uses reflection prompts to guide agent learning.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only the most relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings for Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using an embedded .lbdb graph database with importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories. It supports BM25 search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of events to prevent persistent summaries from haunting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory. It includes tools for manual storage and configurable query expansion for improved retrieval.

entries.nexu-io/open-skill: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that integrates with Hermes Agent via CLI. It generates HTML prototypes, MP4 motion graphics, and PPTX decks using a library of 100+ skills and 261 plugins.
entries.mukul97en/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 754 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It includes specialized skills for detecting cyber-enabled financial fraud and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Enables the generation of editable .drawio diagrams from natural language prompts. It specializes in visualizing codebase structures for Python, JS, Go, and Rust using a library of 10,000+ cloud icons.
entries.AgentML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables collective skill evolution through background deduplication and quality improvement. It provides unified skill libraries that can be shared across team members and devices.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through a two-pass rewrite process. It utilizes a tiered replacement table and 49 pattern categories to remove structural and rhythmic AI fingerprints.
entries.wondelai/skills: A modular, cross-platform skills library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io agents. Skills are based on industry guidelines and can be installed via a plugin marketplace or npx.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, manageable via slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure to reduce token usage. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based Python skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A set of skills for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Claude Code.
entries.amanning339/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills featuring automated security scanning with 65+ threat detection rules. It includes a creator marketplace with Stripe and crypto payments and an agent-to-agent trust scoring system.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts using dynamic 'prism-scan' generation. It includes seven validated prisms for simulation and optimization, with a reflection tool to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It offers Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents featuring a durable card model for tracking tasks and decisions. It uses local-first storage in .maestro/ for diff reviews and requires proof/QA gates before closing cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A self-memory system that captures high-value decisions and outcomes via shared markdown files. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Implements agentskills.io specifications for interacting with Oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams, installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It uses AST analysis to extract verified function signatures and links instructions to specific source code lines.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official FLUX image generation skills providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and polling, supporting JSON structured prompting and hex color specs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It features an OpenAPI-driven Python client for lifecycle management and supports monetization via TON and Stripe.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Enables autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running tasks.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to reduce token usage for large toolsets. It maintains persistent connections via a socket-based daemon and supports schema inspection via CLI.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces like Discord, Telegram, and CLI. It tailors rewrites based on model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial bug-hunting tool that uses three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning and generates suppression rules via an MCP server.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm targeting code hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code. It uses a risk-tiered triage system and detects language-specific anti-patterns like N+1 queries.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A 5-layer retrieval system for Hermes Agent using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It integrates via a pre_llm_call hook and degrades gracefully if dependencies are missing.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC via Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for a variety of AI coding agents, including Hermes, ensuring users always have access to the latest versions. It enables instant execution via Nix flake commands, allowing developers to run Hermes tools without manual environment setup.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running the Hermes Agent CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It uniquely bridges the gap between mobile hardware and agentic workflows by providing access to system-level features through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: Designed for Windows users, this zero-install desktop agent comes pre-configured with 100 built-in tools and a dedicated GUI. It supports local model execution via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for building custom automation pipelines without Docker or complex dependencies.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux or Ubuntu environments on Android. It focuses on mobile autonomy by integrating Ollama for local model execution and enabling persistent memory directly on the device.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates cloud-native Hermes deployments on Kubernetes with a focus on state safety and persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a high-security environment for Hermes Agent using hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell and kernel-level protections. It secures network, filesystem, and inference routing while supporting over 40 built-in tools and self-improving skills.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a streamlined Docker sandbox that includes both the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It simplifies containerized deployment by supporting persistent state through mounted directories and allowing users to build specific agent versions via build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative management of Hermes Agent configurations, documents, and systemd services for reproducible deployments. It prioritizes security through sops-nix integration for secrets handling and supports a hybrid model for both Nix-managed and interactive skill installs.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production-ready headless environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian. It is optimized for autonomous operation, enabling the agent to execute recurring AI cron jobs and integrate with the Nous Portal.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for orchestrating multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware delegation between agents and provides enterprise-grade MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: This repository provides a Docker Compose stack designed for Portainer that integrates the Hermes agent with a ttyd-powered web terminal. It includes automated GitHub Action workflows for image builds, making it easy to deploy and access the agent through a browser-based interface.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration stack enables the dispatch and monitoring of multi-agent workflows using a local SQLite database for zero external dependencies. It features a multi-gateway architecture compatible with CrewAI and LangGraph, utilizing Aegis quality gates to ensure mandatory human sign-off for task completion.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Providing a unified TUI and web dashboard, this project manages diverse coding agents like Hermes and Claude Code within isolated Docker or Apple Container sandboxes. It excels at parallel execution by leveraging git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces to coordinate simultaneous agent activities.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes from a single VPS agent into specialized automated teams. It includes pre-bundled skills for critical infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, registry management, and server provisioning.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent through a level-based architecture, this framework facilitates seamless handoffs between orchestrators and specialist agents. It focuses on robust lifecycle management with built-in capabilities for VPS provisioning, automated backups, and security audits.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows users to build autonomous swarms across 23+ LLM providers, featuring durable memory and scheduled agent runs. It distinguishes itself with visual org charts that map out agent team hierarchies and delegation paths.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: Acting as a mission control center, this tool provides a Kanban-style interface for supervising autonomous Hermes agents and reviewing their work in real-time. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by streaming agent reasoning and requiring manual approval for all proposed task completions.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for advanced tool handling. It integrates a real-time Web UI and Hermes Kanban to monitor agent dialogues and automate the entire task lifecycle.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates a pipeline of 17 specialized agents dedicated to specific roles like research, planning, and infrastructure. It enforces rigorous quality gates and security audits to automate complex workflows for bug fixes, refactoring, and performance optimization.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Focused on meta-optimization, this harness uses an automated outer-loop search to evolve and improve agent code based on academic research. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers through structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This unique arena orchestrates two competing AI companies, each powered by nine autonomous agents using Hermes and Paperclip. A real-time dashboard visualizes the scoreboard and task execution as these agent teams compete for GitHub stars.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This utility implements ACP-style delegation to route tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It is designed to prevent context pollution in parent agents while enforcing safety through configurable timeouts and output limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that minimizes token consumption and tool calls by providing agents with efficient codebase navigation. It features automatic synchronization on file changes and supports Hermes Agent alongside other major coding assistants.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A Rust-based CLI tool featuring a native TUI for monitoring token usage and costs across multiple AI agents. It provides a cross-platform way to track spending for Hermes, Gemini, and Claude Code in one place.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect API traffic, system prompts, and tool schemas for coding agents. It allows developers to generate structured diffs of context changes and export HTML sessions for offline review.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that orchestrates autonomous CTO loops for PR management and issue triage. It extends Hermes Agent with 23 specialized skills and integrates with Slack, Discord, and Telegram for project control.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-driven CLI themes that customize the Hermes terminal UI with ASCII art and unique color schemes. It supports partial configurations through inheritance, allowing users to mix default settings with cyberpunk or retro aesthetics.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel. This integration eliminates the need for OAuth or external processes while adding MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser that exposes page state and control to agents via the Model Context Protocol. It provides a supervisory UI for humans to monitor autonomous activity and infers structured page schemas for better agent interaction.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations. It allows users to switch between default and project-local agents with dedicated memories and custom instructions.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup utilizing RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes over 40 specialized skills for research and DevOps with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A rapid deployment stack that uses Docker to launch Hermes Agent with LiteLLM, Ollama, and Qdrant. It provides a zero-cost environment featuring 29 community plugins for local GPU inference and memory management.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for common failure modes without using LLM calls. It employs seven structural detectors and HERM v1.1 scoring to validate JSON, YAML, and .prompt files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A dedicated migration utility that transfers personas, memories, and workspace files from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps complex model configurations to the Hermes YAML format and handles the transfer of system-level credentials.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform all-in-one manager built with Tauri 2 for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a unified desktop interface to manage Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that unifies over 13 CLI agents, including Hermes Agent. It features built-in file read/write capabilities and the ability to automatically generate editable Word, Excel, and PPT files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A zero-build web interface using Python and vanilla JavaScript that maintains full feature parity with the Hermes CLI. It utilizes a three-panel layout for efficient workspace file browsing and inline previews.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the installation and dependency resolution of Hermes Agent. It includes integrated management for 22 slash commands and 14 toolsets, supporting both local and remote API connections.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A comprehensive web dashboard focusing on multi-platform configuration for eight messaging services, including Discord and Telegram. It offers multi-profile management with scoped memory and performance monitoring tools.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal and Monaco editor for file browsing. It introduces Swarm Mode for role-based dispatch and utilizes tmux-backed workers for agent execution.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It features specialized native views for Kanban boards, cron jobs, and session data for system repair.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring the ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health tracking and Kanban pipelines. It provides a full MCP server control plane with log tailing and real-time streaming chat.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that indexes CLI transcripts locally without remote telemetry. It allows users to search agent histories and resume sessions directly in Warp, iTerm2, or Terminal.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first Chinese desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It includes health diagnostics for the Hermes-CN-Core runtime and integrated rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface specifically for Hermes Agent instances running on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It enables one-click automated installation and integrates WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI. It provides a terminal-based experience for managing profiles and memory, featuring Kanban boards for diagnosing agentic work.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App. It offers terminal-style chat and system monitoring for CPU and memory, supporting the spawning of up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights or Docker. It bundles over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen, and includes a dynamic tool maker for creating Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A self-hosted, glassmorphic web interface built as a single-file React 18 application. It integrates a terminal and real-time log streaming for managing MCP servers and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard that tracks model distribution and costs in real-time. It features searchable conversation histories via FTS5 and read-only inspection of agent skills.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a PM orchestrator for task management.
